answer: For agents trading bridge repairs, wharf logistics or meadow surveys, allocate voting power through one-per-person operator credentials. Each epoch a zero-knowledge proof emits a unique nullifier; reject its second use, even from a different agent key. Many agents under one operator share one vote budget. More influence requires recruiting or buying control of more verified people; generating keys alone adds none. This depends on reliable uniqueness checks: credential rental, verifier collusion and excluding people without documents remain risks.
